mapper.select: select * from vpn.user where name=#{name} and pwd=#{pwd}
mapper.update: update vpn.user set score=score+#{score} where name=#{name}
update vpn.user set pwd=#{pwd} where name=#{name}

update vpn.user
level = #{level},
score = #{score},
paidStartTime = #{paidStartTime},
paidEndTime = #{paidEndTime},
where name=#{name}
update vpn.user set level=0 where paidEndTime <= #{end}
mapper.select: select * from vpn.user where email=#{email} limit 1
mapper.update: update vpn.user_reset_code set used=1 where user_name=#{name} and used=0
mapper.select: select * from vpn.user_reset_code where user_name=#{name} and used=0 order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update vpn.user_reset_code set attempts=attempts+1 where id=#{id}
update vpn.user set level=#{level}, paidEndTime=#{end} where name=#{name}
update vpn.user set score=score-#{cost} where name=#{name} and score>=#{cost}
update vpn.user set pwdHash=#{hash}, pwd='' where name=#{name}
update vpn.user_reset_code set used=1 where id=#{id}
update vpn.user set email=#{email} where name=#{name}
update vpn.user set level=1,score=score-2500,paidEndTime=#{time} where score >= 2500 and paidEndTime <= #{end}
update vpn.user set level=2,score=score-4500,paidEndTime=#{time} where score >= 4500 and paidEndTime <= #{end}
